details.label: Discussion
details.text: A loosely organized MCS continues to propagate eastward as cold pools with surrounding supercells and multicells merge. 04Z mesoanalysis depicts increasing MLCINH, indicating a gradually decoupling boundary layer. Ongoing storms should continue to become progressively elevated with time, which will further limit the severe threat. In the next 1-2 hours though, isolated severe hail or wind may accompany the stronger storm cores given over 2000 J/kg MUCAPE and 40+ kts of effective bulk shear in place
